title: UK Power Station Transformer Dissolved Gas Analysis Data (2010-2015)
scope: Dissolved gas analysis records from 13 UK power-station transformers, with timestamps in UTC and gas concentrations in parts per million.
attribution: Cite Lewis et al. when using these data and retain the Zenodo CC BY 4.0 attribution.
project_note: This dataset is appropriate for real DGA condition-monitoring analysis. It does not provide a failure-event label, health index, load, current, voltage, or temperature field, so it does not support the provisional failure_24h target without an additional authoritative label source.
